latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Sentry Integration skill — list, triage, and resolve Sentry issues, manage releases, and upload source maps via CLI and REST API.

- Provides setup instructions for both npm and pip installations of sentry-cli.
- Documents CLI commands for releases, source map uploads, release management, sending test events, and monitor (cron job) tracking.
- Offers sample REST API queries for listing and resolving issues, getting event and issue details, assigning, ignoring, and bulk actions.
- Includes a practical triage workflow for prioritizing and analyzing Sentry errors.
- Notes on self-hosted Sentry, rate limits, and additional CLI configuration.
